lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular spots arranged in a semi-regular grid on the mid-lateral flank, with prominent larger centroids visible posterior to the branchial region and superior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical light-intensity bands intersecting with horizontal spot rows to form a grid-like lattice across the central lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal ridges visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by sharp high-luminance upper edges and shadowed lower gradients running parallel to the dorsal midline.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A scattered distribution of small, high-luminance blobs visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin at the top left of the frame.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct circular depigmented lesion or scar with a dark outer ring located on the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the gill slits.
other_distinctive_markers: A dense cluster of multiple commensal fish (remoras) attached to the ventral-lateral region immediately posterior to the pectoral fin.
